scripts.setup: npm --prefix fe install && uv --directory be sync
scripts.dev:be: uv --directory be run alembic upgrade head && uv --directory be run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: uv --directory be run ruff check app tests && npm --prefix fe run lint
scripts.format: uv --directory be run ruff format app tests
scripts.typecheck: uv --directory be run mypy app && npm --prefix fe run typecheck
scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory be run alembic upgrade head
